rows.reason: Grade 6 first foreign language already owns the approved transfer to f6-1-etre-passe-check. This package claims no successor.
The old composite expects a broad account of auxiliary choice and agreement, including reflexives. Grade 7 teaches narrower examples and splits those retrievals.
Grade 6 first foreign language already owns the approved transfer to f6-1-negation-check. This package claims no successor.
Relative clauses and partitives are taught separately, and the composite also asks for negation, which is prior learning.
Same retrieval of the nous-stem, all imparfait endings and être as the stem exception. Both Grade 7 curricula teach it. The approved successor is in the first-language path.
The full multi-part account also retrieves the formation rules and a particular translation. Grade 7 teaches those competencies through multiple lessons and exercises.
Adverbial y for location or à plus a thing is outside the Grade 7 requirement for partitive en.
The composite includes the futur simple and y as well as broad en and pronoun placement; it is not equivalent to Grade 7 retrieval.
